title: Conclave: Alt+C opens a dialog that asks the ticked agents to coordinate and share resources
summary: Alt+C opens a Conclave dialog that sends one message to the ticked Claude Code terminals asking them to coordinate; it takes keyboard focus so Esc never reaches the terminal behind it.

deferred.what: The Vitest 'IssueMapModal > F5 and Ctrl+R rebuild the map from GitHub' failed once in a full-suite run on main (expected 1 to be 2) and passed on rerun, so a later gate can go red for no real reason.
